review_text: Bright apartment with a spotless kitchen and an easy self check-in. The host responded quickly when we asked about parking.
Comfortable stay near cafes and transit. The bedroom was quiet, though the hallway lights made the entry feel a little dim at night.
La casa estaba muy limpia y la terraza fue perfecta para desayunar. Las instrucciones de llegada fueron claras.
Good location and friendly communication, but the Wi-Fi dropped during two video calls and the extra towels were hard to find.
The space felt newly renovated, with comfortable beds and thoughtful labels on the appliances. Great fit for a short work trip.
Sehr gute Lage und einfache Anreise. Ein paar mehr Kaffeekapseln waeren schoen gewesen, aber insgesamt war alles gepflegt.
Appartement propre et bien equipe. La rue etait animee le soir, mais les fenetres isolaient assez bien le bruit.
Great natural light, reliable hot water, and a very smooth checkout. The guidebook made it easy to find groceries nearby.
